newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent pares some losses heading to expiry.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent pares some losses heading to expiry.

text.p: Brent crude futures clawed back some earlier losses by late afternoon dealings in Asia as the expiration of the front-month contract later dominated sentiment.
February Brent, on SIMEX, was last traded at $23.60 per barrel, down 24 cents from London's close, after earlier hitting an intraday low of $23.50.
But with February expiring later in London, second position March had attracted most volume. It was last traded at $23.33, down 32 cents from London and to match the intraday low.
NYMEX February crude was last traded at $25.75, down 20 cents from New York, eight cents lower than earlier and near the intraday low.
But most volume had also centred on the March contract, which was last traded at $25.13, down 21 cents from New York and near the intraday low.
Brokers said near-term direction was difficult because of the choppy trading which was likely to persist heading into the expiration.
